cohort: 105 women diagnosed with cervical cancer in pregnancy (CCIP), identified from 17 hospitals in 12 provinces in China between January 2009 and November 2017
finding: The oncologic outcomes of women with CCIP who underwent termination of pregnancy (TOP) were similar to those who continued their pregnancy (COP).
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in maternal survival between women who terminated their pregnancy and those who continued their pregnancy after a cervical cancer diagnosis.
